team.pick: Which team is {label} best known for coaching?
team.match: Match each coach to the team they are best known for coaching.

rows.label: Mike Tomlin
rows.hook: has never had a losing season as head coach of a famously stable NFL franchise

rows.label: Pep Guardiola
rows.description: Spanish association football manager and player (born 1971)
rows.hook: built a possession-based, tiki-taka style side that won a treble and a record-setting run of titles

rows.label: Nick Saban
rows.hook: won seven national titles in college football and is known for a relentless 'process' mindset

rows.label: Bill Belichick
rows.hook: won six Super Bowls as a head coach and is famous for hooded sweatshirts and terse press conferences

rows.label: Jürgen Klopp
rows.hook: is known for 'heavy metal football', gegenpressing and big bear hugs on the touchline

rows.label: John Madden
rows.hook: won a Super Bowl as coach, then became a beloved broadcaster whose name is on a best-selling video game series

rows.label: Andy Reid
rows.hook: is a mustached, cheeseburger-loving head coach known for a creative offense and multiple Super Bowl wins

rows.label: Brian Clough
rows.hook: was a brash, quotable manager who won back-to-back European Cups with a small provincial club

rows.label: Alex Ferguson
rows.description: Scottish association football manager and former player (born 1941)
rows.hook: won 13 league titles and two Champions Leagues in 26 years, famous for the 'hairdryer treatment'

rows.label: Sean Payton
rows.hook: led a city's team to its first Super Bowl win, aided by a bold onside kick call

rows.label: Mike Ditka
rows.description: American football player, coach, and television commentator (born 1939)
rows.hook: is a mustached tight end turned coach with a famously gruff, tough-guy persona and a Super Bowl title

rows.label: Diego Simeone
rows.description: Argentine association football player and manager (born 1970)
rows.hook: is an intense, touchline-prowling manager famous for a gritty, defensive 'cholismo' style

rows.label: Pete Carroll
rows.hook: is a high-energy coach who won a college national title and a Super Bowl, known for gum-chewing enthusiasm

rows.label: Gregg Popovich
rows.hook: is a gruff, sardonic coach who won five NBA titles and was famous for terse sideline interviews

rows.label: Bill Parcells
rows.hook: is nicknamed 'the Big Tuna' and won two Super Bowls with one franchise

rows.label: Phil Jackson
rows.description: American basketball player, coach and executive
rows.hook: is the 'Zen Master' who won six NBA titles with one team and five with another

rows.label: Arsène Wenger
rows.hook: is a professor-like manager who led his club through a whole league season unbeaten

rows.label: Bear Bryant
rows.hook: is a houndstooth-hat-wearing college coaching legend who won six national championships

rows.label: Vince Lombardi
rows.description: American football player, coach, and executive (1913-1970)
rows.hook: is a famously demanding coach whose name is on the Super Bowl trophy and who won the first two championships

rows.label: Didier Deschamps
rows.description: French association football player and coach
rows.hook: captained a World Cup winning side as a player, then won the tournament again as a manager

rows.label: Don Shula
rows.hook: holds the record for most wins by an NFL head coach and led the only perfect season in league history

rows.label: Pat Riley
rows.description: American basketball player, coach and executive
rows.hook: is a slicked-back-hair coach famous for 'Showtime' basketball and a guarantee of a repeat title

rows.label: Tom Landry
rows.hook: is a fedora-wearing, stone-faced coach who led his team to twenty straight winning seasons

rows.label: Steve Kerr
rows.hook: is a sharpshooting former player who coached a team to a record 73-win season and several titles

rows.label: Tony Dungy
rows.hook: was the first Black head coach to win a Super Bowl and is known for a calm, faith-driven approach

rows.label: Joe Torre
rows.hook: managed a dynasty that won four World Series titles in five years in the late 1990s

rows.label: George Halas
rows.description: American football player, coach, and team owner (1895-1983)
rows.hook: is nicknamed 'Papa' and was a founding figure of the NFL who won six league championships as a coach

rows.label: Matt Busby
rows.hook: rebuilt his club after a deadly airplane crash and won the first European Cup for an English side

rows.label: Lionel Scaloni
rows.hook: led his country to a World Cup trophy in a thrilling penalty shootout final after a long wait

rows.label: Mike Krzyzewski
rows.hook: is known as 'Coach K', the all-time wins leader in men's major college basketball

rows.label: Gareth Southgate
rows.description: English professional football manager and former player (born 1970)
rows.hook: wears a waistcoat on the touchline and led his country to a European Championship final

rows.label: Tommy Lasorda
rows.hook: is a famously fiery, spaghetti-loving manager who bled blue and won two World Series

rows.label: Tony La Russa
rows.hook: is a lawyer-turned-manager who won World Series titles with two clubs and popularized specialized bullpen use

rows.label: Bill Walsh
rows.hook: invented the 'West Coast offense' and won three Super Bowls

rows.label: Chuck Noll
rows.hook: is the only coach to win four Super Bowls with the same franchise, building a 1970s 'Steel Curtain' dynasty

rows.label: John Wooden
rows.hook: is the 'Wizard of Westwood' who won ten national championships and taught a famous 'pyramid of success'

rows.label: Knute Rockne
rows.hook: is a legendary coach famous for the 'Win one for the Gipper' speech and the forward pass

rows.label: Erik Spoelstra
rows.hook: led a team through a 'Big Three' era with several straight NBA Finals trips and championships

rows.label: Vicente del Bosque
rows.hook: is a mild-mannered, mustached manager who won a World Cup and two European Championships in a row

rows.label: Geno Auriemma
rows.hook: is a winning machine who has led his team to a dozen national titles, with several undefeated seasons

rows.label: Pat Summitt
rows.hook: retired as college basketball's winningest coach, with eight national titles

rows.label: Joachim Löw
rows.hook: led his country to a World Cup title in Brazil after years as an assistant, known for his scarf and tidy style

rows.label: Red Auerbach
rows.hook: is the cigar-smoking coach who lit up a victory cigar and won nine NBA championships
